```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

set.seed(8105)

data("ny_noaa")

noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    year = year(date),
    month = factor(month.abb[month(date)], levels = month.abb)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin),
    tmin <= tmax, tmax <= 42, tmin >= -47
  ) |>
  select(id, date, year, month, tmax, tmin)
```

The raw data has `r format(nrow(ny_noaa), big.mark = ",")` station-days. I converted temperatures from tenths of degrees C to degrees C, kept station-days with both a maximum and a minimum temperature, and dropped `r format(sum(!is.na(ny_noaa$tmax) & !is.na(ny_noaa$tmin)) - nrow(noaa_df), big.mark = ",")` implausible records (minimum above maximum, or outside New York's record range of about -47 to 42 °C).


Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily maximum temperature by month, 2010

```{r}
noaa_df |>
  filter(year == 2010) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, y = ~tmax, type = "box",
    fillcolor = "rgba(42, 120, 214, 0.25)",
    line = list(color = "#2a78d6", width = 2),
    marker = list(color = "#2a78d6", size = 4, opacity = 0.4)
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

> All `r format(sum(noaa_df$year == 2010), big.mark = ",")` station-days from 2010 with valid temperatures.

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily minimum vs. maximum temperature, 2010

```{r}
noaa_df |>
  filter(year == 2010) |>
  slice_sample(n = 3000) |>
  mutate(
    season = if_else(
      month %in% month.abb[5:10],
      "Warm months (May-Oct)", "Cold months (Nov-Apr)"
    ),
    season = fct_relevel(season, "Cold months (Nov-Apr)"),
    text_label = str_c(
      "Station: ", id, "<br>Date: ", date,
      "<br>Max: ", tmax, " °C<br>Min: ", tmin, " °C"
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, color = ~season, colors = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"),
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.5),
    text = ~text_label, hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom")
  )
```

> Random sample of 3,000 station-days from 2010.

### Mean daily maximum temperature in January and July, 1981-2010

```{r}
jan_jul_df =
  noaa_df |>
  filter(month %in% c("Jan", "Jul")) |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    n_stations = n_distinct(id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = fct_recode(fct_drop(month), January = "Jan", July = "Jul"),
    text_label = str_c(
      month, " ", year, "<br>Mean max: ", round(mean_tmax, 1),
      " °C<br>Stations: ", n_stations
    )
  )

jan_jul_df |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~mean_tmax, color = ~month, colors = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"),
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line = list(width = 2), marker = list(size = 8),
    text = ~text_label, hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Mean daily max temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom")
  )
```

> Averages over all stations reporting in that month. January varies much more from year to year than July.
